summary: The fund invests primarily in common stocks of U.S. companies that have above-average potential for revenue or earnings growth. The manager emphasizes investments in large and mid capitalization growth companies. The fund will invest, under normal market conditions, at least 80% of its assets in common stocks of U.S. companies that Sands Capital believes have above-average potential for revenue or earnings growth.
